idea-plugin.name: Oracle Dictionary Inspector
idea-plugin.description:
DataGrip / IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate plugin for Oracle dictionary inspection.

Toad-style describe dialogs for tables, views, procedures, functions, plus a dedicated Tool Window for sessions and locks.

  • Table dialog: Columns / Keys / FK / Indexes / Checks / Data preview with 500-row paging and WHERE/ORDER BY filters / DDL / SELECT
  • Procedure / Function dialog: IntelliJ Editor source with line numbers, syntax highlighting, and compile-error line markers; Errors tab double-click jumps to source
  • Alt+Shift+O describe action recognises TABLE / VIEW / PROCEDURE / FUNCTION / PACKAGE / SEQUENCE / SYNONYM (SCHEMA.NAME supported); prefers the current dialog's OWNER
  • Oracle Sessions tool window: V$SESSION browser with USER / STATUS / PROGRAM / MODULE filters, 5-second auto-refresh, per-session Current SQL, and a Locks tab joining V$LOCKED_OBJECT + V$SESSION + ALL_OBJECTS. Right-click → Kill Session.
  • Localised: English (default), Korean (한국어).

DataGrip / IntelliJ IDEA Ultimate에서 Oracle 딕셔너리(테이블·뷰·프로시저·펑션·패키지·시퀀스·시노님·세션·락)를 탭 다이얼로그와 전용 Tool Window로 빠르게 보여주는 플러그인입니다. Toad 스타일 Describe + 페이징 데이터 미리보기 + PL/SQL 컴파일 오류 라인 강조 + 실시간 세션/락 브라우저 + Explain Plan 시각화 제공.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0 — initial release

Object dialogs

  • Tables / Views — Columns / Keys / FK / Indexes / Checks / Triggers / Data preview (500-row paging + WHERE/ORDER BY) / DDL / SELECT / Comments SQL.
  • Views use ALL_VIEWS.TEXT for the DDL tab (CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW).
  • Standalone Procedures / Functions — Source (IntelliJ editor, syntax + line-number markers for compile errors) / Execute template / Errors (double-click jumps to source line) / Arguments.
  • Packages — Spec / Body / Routines / Errors with per-source-type error highlighting and double-click jump.
  • Sequences / Synonyms — Property/Value dialogs.

Oracle Sessions tool window

  • Sessions / Locks / Long Ops tabs with auto-refresh (5s).
  • Sessions tab has client-side USER / STATUS / PROGRAM / MODULE filter.
  • Bottom sub-tabs: Current SQL, Wait History (V$SESSION_WAIT_HISTORY), Session Stats (curated V$SESSTAT), Explain Plan (V$SQL_PLAN with expensive-operation highlighting).
  • Right-click → Kill Session / Kill Holder with confirmation dialog.

Editor describe action

  • Single Alt+Shift+O shortcut handles every object type, supports SCHEMA.NAME, prefers the current dialog's OWNER.

Cross-cutting

  • Inline search on every table (just start typing).
  • Column widths persist via PropertiesComponent.
  • Localised: English (default) + Korean.
